_comment: Stage 2, V ablation at fixed P (bots/p_only/EXPERIMENTS.md). Fresh tuning seed 20261108. Every arm uses a mixed model set (training/export_mixed.py): policy XL or XXL with the same value M; each V-off/V-on pair shares identical P weights. Fixed-time deployment games. B-A and D-C: V's increment at P-XL and P-XXL; C-A and D-B: P capacity with V off and on; interaction D-C-B+A. V coefficients are the experimental defaults (C08 refine 50, beam 35; v12 rollout 40), not tuned values.
